title: Know what counts as public value
text: Get a clear way to say what your work is worth to the public, beyond money saved. You will have words that leaders, funders, and colleagues all understand.

title: Get more from every pound
text: Learn how to tell whether a service is economical, efficient, and effective, and fair too, so you can improve it and defend it with confidence.

title: Map how change really happens
text: Draw the chain from what you do to the lasting difference you want, so you measure the right things from day one instead of guessing later.

title: Prove your work made a difference
text: Find out what would have happened anyway, so you can claim credit honestly and show funders results they can trust.

title: Show the return on doing good
text: Turn social benefits into a clear ratio your finance team and funders can read, without turning it into a marketing number.
link: Read about social return on investment

title: Choose measures that do not mislead
text: Pick a small set of indicators that guide good decisions and cannot be easily gamed, so reports tell you what is really going on.
